story.soThat: I can ask anything and receive structured answers with metadata
story.tasks: - Implement Typer-based CLI entrypoint `jarvis query "question"` (CLI + module form). - Wire query command into JARVIS CLI main app. - Implement RAG loop: embed query, search Qdrant, build context block. - Call selected LLM via `call_llm` with provider routing. - Return human-readable answer with citations in CLI. - Add JSON response envelope (`--json-output`) for MCP / tool integrations. - Include chunk IDs / metadata for linking back to workspace files. - Ensure error handling for empty results and provider failures.

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. Given memories exist, When the user runs `jarvis query "question"`, Then the system embeds the query, fetches top-k context, calls the selected LLM, and returns text with cited sources. 2. Given the CLI query succeeds, When called with `--json-output`, Then the response includes a JSON envelope with `query`, `response`, `sources[]`, and `metadata` matching the PRD shape. 3. Given chunk metadata in Qdrant, When results are returned, Then each source entry includes enough information (source_file, domain, optional chunk_id) to map back to workspace files. 4. Given provider routing is configured, When `provider="auto"` is used, Then the system prefers free/cheap providers and falls back to others only when necessary.

doc.title: Epic 3 — Story 3.1
doc.snippet:
As a knowledge worker, I want a `jarvis query "question"` command, So that I can ask anything and receive structured answers with metadata.
Given memories exist, When the user queries via CLI or MCP, Then the system embeds the query, fetches top-k context, calls the selected LLM, and returns text + cited sources, And results stream progressively to the terminal.

artifact.reason: Implements the RAG query CLI command for Story 3.1, including Typer wiring, context construction, LLM call, human output, and JSON envelope.
Top-level Typer app; wires `query_cli.query` into the main CLI so `python -m jarvis.cli.main query` is available.
Provides semantic search over Qdrant; used by the query command to fetch top-k context chunks with metadata.
LLM client and provider router used by the query command to call the selected model and track cost.
